text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The new occupant, the University of St. Gallen, is very pleased with the climate in the rooms and the energy costs.", "gist": "University of St. Gallen is satisfied with room climate and energy costs."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "“Kegel’s Rule” could catch on in the refurbishment of further office buildings as well as in dwelling house construction and new builds.", "gist": "Kegel’s Rule may be adopted in future office and residential construction projects."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Umwelt Arena Schweiz", "gist": "Umwelt Arena Schweiz"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "René Schmid Architekten AG", "gist": "René Schmid Architekten AG"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Männedorf", "gist": "Männedorf (location)"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Walter Schmid, energy pioneer and president of Stiftung Umwelt Arena Schweiz, and his son, architect René Schmid, René Schmid Architekten AG in Zurich, are relying on energy self-sufficiency with interconnection.", "gist": "Walter Schmid and René Schmid are using energy self-sufficiency with interconnection in their Männedorf development."}]}
